rule.text: I call my grandmother every Wednesday.
Solveig Rasmussen, my manager, asked me to lead the next sprint review.
The farmers market in my neighborhood in Cleveland opens again this weekend.
I'm training for a half marathon.
I'll paste this into Logseq, which is where I keep my notes.
Our weekly team meeting is on Thursday.
Give me three tips for writing clearer emails.
We need to ship Project Meridian by November 22.
When you suggest restaurants, remember that I eat pescatarian.
Reorg news: my new manager is Renata Nakashima.
Can you draft a short message to my team?
I stopped using Logseq and moved all my notes to OneNote.
My doctor suggested a change, so I eat keto now instead of pescatarian.
I just finished moving, so home is Raleigh now.
My favorite author is Ursula K.
How do I calculate compound interest?
I'm saving up for a new bike.
I want to learn some basic Portuguese this year.
